# VectorAscii2Binary

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/VectorAscii2Binary`

```text
VectorAscii2Binary, version 0.01

Usage: VectorAscii2Binary [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-vector : name of the file containing the ASCII vector
    -o, --output-vector : name of the file where the vector will be stored in binary
    -r, --rational : indicate that the input vector has rational coefficients
    -c, --complex : indicate that the input vector has complexl coefficients
    --use-longlong : use 128bit(64bits) integers instead of 64bits(32bits) integers in rational mode
```
